scope: Realtime for one environment on a running installation: turned on through the management API, then used by two supabase-js clients through the gateway for broadcast, presence and database changes on a table with row level security, and the broadcast REST API; a wrong key refused; turned off again.

checks.check: operator native MFA session authorizes management
a provisioned environment exists
Realtime starts off
a socket is refused while Realtime is off
an owner turns Realtime on
the supervisor starts the environment's Realtime
connection details list Realtime
a new public table is published to Realtime
checks.detail:
NOTICE:  policy "probe_read" for relation "public.realtime_probe" does not exist, skipping
NOTICE:  policy "probe_write" for relation "public.realtime_probe" does not exist, skipping

checks.check: a wrong key never reaches Realtime
a client subscribes to broadcast, presence and database changes
a second client joins the same channel
a broadcast from one client reaches the other
both clients see each other in presence
Realtime confirms it is listening for database changes
a visitor inserts a row through REST
the insert arrives as a database change
the broadcast REST API answers through the gateway
the owner turns Realtime off
Realtime is off again
a socket is refused once Realtime is off
